title: Canada's Alphonso Davies exits vs. Guatemala with injury
text:
Canada's Alphonso Davies exits vs. Guatemala with injury - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Canada's Alphonso Davies exits vs. Guatemala with injury
 Sportsnet Staff @Sportsnet November 13, 2026 - 9:34pm Watch as star Alphonso Davies falls to the turf with an apparent injury less than five minutes into Canada's Concacaf Nation's League match vs. Guatemala, then is subbed off. 
 Alphonso Davies can't seem to catch a break when it comes to donning the Canada jersey. 
 The superstar full-back exited Canada's Concacaf Nations League game against Guatemala Friday night after suffering an apparent injury.
 Davies appeared to slip on the grass inside the 18-yard box as Guatemala threatened in the fifth minute of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal opener.
 The Canadian star got back to his feet and attempted to block Darwin Lom's shot before calling to the bench. 
 A grim-faced Davies, who missed most of the FIFA World Cup earlier this year due to a hamstring injury, walked off the pitch without assistance. Ralph Priso came in as a substitute at the six-minute mark.
 Friday's game against Guatemala marked Davies' return to the CANMNT starting lineup after missing the majority of his home World Cup. He appeared only once through Canada's five-game run, coming in as a substitute and playing 15 minutes in the Round of 32 win over South Africa. 
 The 26-year-old has been on and off the pitch since suffering a torn ACL in late March 2025 during a Concacaf Nations League match for Canada, and has dealt with a string of hamstring issues since returning from that major injury.
 However, he's appeared back at full health this season with Bayern Munich, appearing in 15 games in all competitions for the German club while adding three goals and five assists. 
 He missed Canada's September-October international break while honeymooning with his wife.
 Canada and Guatemala will play the second leg on Monday night in Toronto.
 -- with files from the Canadian Press
